jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager Inspection
jobs.reason: This is a B2B sales role in inspection/assurance services — pure commercial sales with no policy, research, or intelligence component, putting it firmly outside all three of the candidate's target zones. The role requires demonstrable sales-target achievement and account management experience the candidate does not have, and working French at professional level would likely be required.

jobs.title: Freelance Auditor HKZ Ambulancezorg/GHOR/GGD
jobs.reason: This is a healthcare quality auditor role requiring demonstrable experience in Dutch ambulance/GHOR/GGD services and HKZ certification standards — entirely outside the candidate's field. It also effectively requires working Dutch (the candidate has only A1) and sector-specific auditing credentials the candidate does not hold.

jobs.title: Lead Assessor Lift
jobs.reason: Complete mismatch — this is a technical lift/elevator certification auditor role requiring an engineering degree in Mechanics/Electricity, 5+ years in the Lifts Industry, and deep knowledge of EU Lifts Directive standards. Hard ineligibility triggered on multiple counts: specialist engineering qualification the candidate lacks, 5+ years hard experience requirement, and French at C level for client-facing work.

jobs.title: Lead Auditor - Multi Standard
jobs.reason: This is an ISO management systems auditing role (quality, environmental, H&S) requiring a technical/engineering background and current industry experience in a Quality/EHS role. It has no overlap with the candidate's IR, policy, or intelligence focus, and requires specialist auditor competencies they do not hold.

jobs.title: Programme Manager (Executive Education)
jobs.reason: The role requires a minimum of 5 years' relevant work experience plus 3 years in higher education administration and a valid driver's licence — hard ineligibility on seniority. The field (executive education programme management) is also only weakly related to the candidate's IR/policy research focus.

jobs.title: Consultancy: Global Comparative Study — "Captured justice: Judicial and institutional capture, civic space, and transitional justice"
jobs.reason: Transitional justice and impunity research is a core field fit for the candidate's international law and atrocity-prevention interests. However, consultancy roles leading a global comparative study typically expect substantial prior research/consulting experience and likely a doctoral-level profile, which is a stretch for an MSc-in-progress candidate; specific comparative legal-research methodology may also be a partial gap.
